forbidden.name: lib-is-pure
forbidden.comment: src/lib holds framework-agnostic analytical libs (CLAUDE.md's Playground architecture section: "Analytical panels ... are pure libs in src/lib/ with a thin component each") — a lib importing a component couples pure compute to React, defeating the point of factoring it out. Type-only imports are exempt: they're erased at compile time and carry no runtime coupling (see docs/exploration for the same reasoning applied to madge's circular-import check).
